title: eat shit & die 180
author: bpatrick
html:
Thanks to Jonny Paycheck for keeping me on track! This one made me laugh when I thought of it. It kind of surprised me. Next week is the last week of finals and then: Summer of Comics!

A big thank you to Winston Rountree for recommending akimbo in an interview here (and here) and if you’re not already an avid fan of subnormality then I can’t do anything for you.
